```java

    String  role      = "Full Stack Software Engineer";
```

I build **microservices, event-driven systems, and developer tools**. My work sits between backend engineering, observability, and security: REST APIs with Spring Boot, durable workflows with Inngest, and containerized scanning pipelines.

- 🔭 Building **Spectre**, an observability and incident management platform
- 🌱 Currently integrating **Kafka** and **Redis** into Spectre for alert correlation
- 🏆 Finalist at **AutonomousHacks** and **Build for Billions: IndiaStack**
- 🤝 Project Admin for **SecDev** in **GSSoC**, leading contributors and managing PR workflows
- 📚 Strong fundamentals in **DSA, OS, DBMS, Computer Networks, and System Design**

### 📡 [Spectre](https://github.com/deekshithgowda85/Spec)

**Observability & Incident Management Platform**

Self-hosted platform to monitor services and manage incidents end to end.

- Spring Boot microservices with API Gateway routing
- JWT auth, BCrypt hashing, and role-based access
- Incident APIs: severity filters, lifecycle transitions, acknowledgements, resolutions, event timelines
- Integrating Kafka and Redis for alert correlation and live dashboard updates

### 🤖 [Sprint](https://agile-scrum-master.vercel.app)

**Agentic Scrum Manager**

AI-powered sprint planning built as a modular microservices system.

- 5 service containers: Next.js BFF, Express API gateway, FastAPI AI service
- LLM-driven sprint planning using Groq
- Multi-tenant isolation: per-organization PostgreSQL databases resolved from JWT claims
- Inngest durable functions turn GitHub and Jira webhooks into sprint tasks, with BullMQ, retries, and a dead-letter queue

### 🐳 [Dockium](https://github.com/deekshithgowda85/dockium)

**Desktop Security Workbench**

Cross-platform desktop app that brings Docker, proxy capture, and vulnerability scanning into one place.

- Electron main process controls container lifecycle, React renderer handles the UI
- Containerized Nuclei scans, isolated from the host
- Playwright automates browser sessions and captures proxy traffic
- Standalone `dockium` CLI with Git pre-push hooks, commit audit logs, and live push reports
